title: 摔不碎的手机你想要吗
desc: 摔不碎的手机你想要吗

paragraphs.en: For many worldwide, smartphones are used for everything from financial transactions to social media.
paragraphs.zh: 对于全球许多人来说，智能手机被用于从金融交易到社交媒体等方方面面。

paragraphs.en: So when screens break or crack, it can feel like life itself comes to a halt.
paragraphs.zh: 当手机屏幕破裂时，感觉生活仿佛都停滞了。

paragraphs.en: Long-time US glassmaker Corning has spent more than a decade making smartphone glass stronger.
paragraphs.zh: 美国老牌玻璃制造商康宁公司花了十多年时间，让智能手机玻璃变得更坚固。

paragraphs.en: These devices are typically a much higher percentage of a person's GDP in emerging regions, so durability and longevity of that phone becomes a much more critical feature than in other developed countries.
paragraphs.zh: 在新兴地区，这些设备的价格通常占个人GDP的比例要高得多，所以与其他发达国家相比，手机的耐用性和使用寿命就成了更为关键的特性。

paragraphs.en: Corning founded in 1851 has pivoted with the times. In 1879, Thomas Edison went to Corning for glass for his light bulb.
paragraphs.zh: 康宁公司于1851年成立，一直与时俱进。1879年，托马斯·爱迪生前往康宁公司，为他的灯泡寻找玻璃材料。

paragraphs.en: Corning's glasses used in the windows for NASA's space shuttles.
paragraphs.zh: 康宁公司的玻璃被用于美国国家航空航天局航天飞机的舷窗。

paragraphs.en: In the 1950s, Corning became a household name with Corningware cookware, and Steve Jobs used it for the iphone.
paragraphs.zh: 20世纪50年代，康宁凭借康宁餐具家喻户晓，史蒂夫·乔布斯还将其用于iPhone手机。

paragraphs.en: Now Corning dominates the worldwide smartphone glass industry.
paragraphs.zh: 如今，康宁公司主导着全球智能手机玻璃行业。

paragraphs.en: Its latest product Gorilla Glass Victus is even tougher, says the company.
paragraphs.zh: 该公司表示，其最新产品“Gorilla Glass Victus”更加坚固耐用。

paragraphs.en: Whenever we develop a new glass, we set the bar high.
paragraphs.zh: 每当我们研发一种新玻璃时，我们都会设定很高的标准。

paragraphs.en: The new glass must be clearly better than our current flagship product and far superior to the competition.
paragraphs.zh: 新玻璃必须明显优于我们目前的旗舰产品，并且远远胜过竞争对手的产品。

paragraphs.en: Corning said they were able to improve both drop and scratch performance at the same time, a first in the industry.
paragraphs.zh: 康宁公司表示，他们能够同时提升抗摔性能和抗刮性能，这在业内尚属首次。

paragraphs.en: Gorilla Glass Victus can drop from two meters in height, which is taller than I am, onto a rough surface like asphalt and has 2x better scratch performance than our previous glass.
paragraphs.zh: Gorilla Glass Victus玻璃能从两米高的地方（这比我还高）掉到像沥青这样的粗糙表面上 ，而且其抗刮性能是我们之前玻璃的两倍。

paragraphs.en: So the next time you drop your phone and it miraculously doesn't shatter, it's most likely thanks to this company in upstate New York.
paragraphs.zh: 下次你不小心把手机掉地上，而它奇迹般地没有摔碎时，这很可能要归功于纽约州北部的这家公司。
